image_split: SHA256(hcsn-round2-split: + COCO filename) integer modulo 10; 0..4 train, 5..6 calibration, 7..9 test
natural_caption_scope: custom image-disjoint subset, synthetic temporal assembly; not the full official benchmark or a natural video benchmark
frozen_encoder: official openai/CLIP ViT-B/32, source d05afc436d78f1c48dc0dbf8e5980a9d471f35f6, weights SHA256 40d365715913c9da98579312b702a82c18be219cc2a73407c4526f58eba950af
cifar_training_features: existing round1 train rows, known classes 0..7 only
cifar_new_calibration: next 16 training rows per known class after round1 first 24 rows per class
cifar_new_test: next 32 test rows per each of 10 classes after round1 first 16 rows per class
cifar_threshold: ID-only third-party-free calibration; lower empirical 5th percentile, deterministic ties; report actual ID coverage and unknown acceptance
cifar_diagnostic: also compare all methods at the same empirical test ID coverage, explicitly retrospective ROC diagnostics, never deployment threshold selection
training_target: only last-observed image/text embeddings; model inputs exclude target, image ID, split, hard-negative label and future tokens
outcomes: online frozen-encoder cost with and without exact-input caching
no_claims: real joules without a hardware counter
